title: MV-Debate: Multi-view Agent Debate with Dynamic Reflection Gating for Multimodal Harmful Content Detection in Social Media
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical task of detecting harmful content (hate speech, sarcasm, misinformation) on social media using a multi-agent debate framework. While these topics involve social safety and ethics, the research objective is to improve classification accuracy and efficiency through a new architectural approach (MV-Debate) rather than to evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical systems, philosophies, or hermeneutics.
